## Type of change

- [ ] 🐛 Fix (broken example, wrong import, typo, clarification)
- [ ] ✨ Addition (new pattern, example, or reference section)
- [ ] 🔄 Change (restructure / breaking guidance)
- [ ] 🆕 New skill
- [ ] 🧰 Tooling / repo housekeeping (no skill content change)

## Checklist

- [ ] Java snippets compile against the engine API (correct imports — e.g. `engine.strategy.StrategyProperty`)
- [ ] `SKILL.md` frontmatter is valid (`name` kebab-case, `description`, `metadata.version`)
- [ ] Version bumped in lockstep (`marketplace.json` `plugins[].version` **and** `SKILL.md` `metadata.version`) — _skip if no content change_
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]` — _skip if no content change_
- [ ] README roadmap / snippets updated if affected
